findings.mitigation: Keep the change visible in Prism review evidence and rely on provider raw outputs plus resolution checks, not only local timeout behavior.

findings.summary: No working-tree diff was present for the dispatcher used to call providers.
findings.mitigation: Provider dispatch behavior remains governed by the existing dispatcher.

findings.mitigation: Do not use hook changes as the sole proof of completion; require E2E hook event evidence and complete-revival host audit.
